non_face_reference.subject: subdivided Suzanne, single rendered view, marching cubes 256
non_face_reference.unit: fraction of the subject's longest axis

measured_accuracy.note: No face accuracy has been measured. The non-face reference figure was obtained on a rendered geometric subject and does not transfer to a human face. Filling face_benchmark would require faces with reference scans, which this repository does not have; producing them from rendered heads would yield a number about rendered heads.
